title: What artificial intelligence can do for high-performance computing systems?
core_idea: A systematic review assessing how AI (including ML and optimization) can improve the efficiency and operation of high-performance computing systems by surveying recent literature and categorizing approaches across key application areas.
tldr: Survey of recent literature on applying AI/ML to improve operational efficiency of HPC systems; manually screened ~1,800 papers (2019–2025) and organized 74 retained works into six application areas: performance estimation, performance optimization, scheduling, surrogate modeling, fault detection, and language-model-based automation.
